pandora_intro.speaker: Pandora
pandora_intro.text: Hello there. I've been waiting for you.

pandora_purpose.speaker: Pandora
pandora_purpose.text: I am Pandora's Box. I have pulled you into this world for a purpose.

choices.text: Who are you? Why am I here?
This is a dream. I'm going back to sleep.
I will do whatever you ask.

response_curious.speaker: Pandora
response_curious.text: Curiosity. Good. That will keep you alive longer than most.

response_skeptical.speaker: Pandora
response_skeptical.text: A dream, you say. We shall see how long you keep believing that.

response_obedient.speaker: Pandora
response_obedient.text: Obedience. How... convenient. Let's see if that lasts.
